title: Off Season 2
author: Mike Fitz 💪
desc: **Off Season 2** is a comprehensive 12-week training program designed to build strength and endurance during your off-season. Comprising six workouts per week, this program focuses on progressive overload and varied training modalities to keep you engaged and challenged. Each session targets key muscle groups while incorporating functional movements to enhance your overall athletic performance. Get ready to elevate your fitness and come back stronger than ever!
